chunks: "Indeed, Allah, Mighty and Majestic, revealed to Musa عليه السلام not to kill the Samaritan, for indeed he is generous."

key_terms.مُوسَىٰ: Musa عليه السلام, the prophet addressed by revelation
key_terms.ٱلسَّامِرِيَّ: the Samaritan, the person mentioned in the report
key_terms.ٱللَّهَ: Allah, the Divine speaker in the narration

ai.seo_question: Why was Musa عليه السلام told not to kill the Samaritan?
ai.summary: This narration states that Allah عزّ وجلّ commanded Musa عليه السلام not to kill the Samaritan. It highlights generosity as a weighty moral quality, showing the high regard given to munificence in the ethical teaching of the tradition.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: It is narrated: "Allah (swt), the Almighty and Glorious, revealed to Musa (as) not to kill the Samaritan, saying, 'Indeed, he is generous.'"
